# Accessibility Checklist: ART-005 - Gallery Completion - Knowledge, Reports & Editors

**Purpose**: Validate accessibility requirements quality for the seven ART-005 gallery artifact slices before task generation and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist accessibility` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are keyboard traversal requirements specified for every interactive control across all seven artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are visible focus requirements specified for controls and focusable recovery targets in both reader and editor artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements present for light/dark parity, reduced-motion behavior, and color-independent status or priority meaning across the full seven-artifact matrix? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-005, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK004 Does the requirement set define the exact ART-020 prevention pattern for every meaningful overflow scroll container: focusable actual scroll element, programmatic name, grouping semantics, and no positive tabindex? [Resolved, Completeness, Spec §Accessibility Contract Detail, Spec §FR-014, Contract §Gallery Template]
- [x] CHK005 Are clipboard failure and manual-copy fallback requirements complete enough to cover unavailable clipboard, rejected promise, synchronous throw, exact fallback text, and focus movement? [Completeness, Spec §Clipboard behavior, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the exact export control label `Copy as Markdown` specified for each producer, avoiding ambiguous export affordance wording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]
- [x] CHK007 Are contrast requirements for locally introduced colors and meaningful non-text indicators tied to audited Racecraft tokens or explicit per-theme contrast evidence? [Resolved, Clarity, Spec §Accessibility Contract Detail, Spec §FR-014, Contract §Gallery Template]
- [x] CHK008 Are reduced-motion requirements clear about disabling required animation, transitions, and smooth scrolling, rather than only avoiding decorative animation? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK009 Are accessible-name requirements clear for all controls, including icon-like controls, generated theme controls, editor controls, and transient simulation controls? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Design Concept §Q8]
- [x] CHK010 Are dynamic success, failure, warning, dependency, and editor-state messages specified as programmatically determinable status, not just visible text? [Resolved, Clarity, Spec §Accessibility Contract Detail, Contract §Gallery Template, Contract §Editor Markdown Exports]

## Interaction Structure Coverage

- [x] CHK011 Are the concept explainer's transient add/remove/reset and slider controls covered by keyboard, focus, accessible-name, and reduced-motion requirements without requiring an export? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Slice 2]
- [x] CHK012 Does the slide-deck requirement set specify accessible slide navigation structure, including named controls, current slide or position text, focus behavior after slide changes, and no auto-rotation assumption? [Resolved, Coverage, Spec §Accessibility Contract Detail, Plan §Slice 1, Contract §Gallery Template]
- [x] CHK013 Are status-report and incident-report reading structures covered by requirements for headings, lists, timeline/report sections, status labels, impact, blockers, and follow-up information that do not rely on color alone? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK014 Are feature-flag requirements sufficient for named checkbox/toggle controls, dependency warning text, grouped flag structure, and color-independent enabled/disabled or issue meaning? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Slice 6]
- [x] CHK015 Are triage-board requirements sufficient to prevent pointer-only drag/drop or color-only priority filtering by specifying named board columns, tickets, filters, reset/export controls, and keyboard-operable ticket movement? [Resolved, Coverage, Spec §Accessibility Contract Detail, Plan §Slice 5, Contract §Gallery Template]
- [x] CHK016 Are prompt-tuner requirements sufficient for labels on the editor, sample controls, slot fields, derived preview, reset/export controls, and keyboard traversal through multiline and Unicode content? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Slice 7]

## Acceptance Evidence Quality

- [x] CHK019 Does the UAT evidence schema require structured accessibility observations for focus order, focused fallback target, scroll-region selector/role/name/tabindex, status-region semantics, and contrast evidence source? ## Consistency And Scope

- [x] CHK023 Are reader and producer accessibility requirements consistent with their semantic export classifications, so reader controls do not imply missing exports and producer exports remain keyboard accessible? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK024 Are per-slice accessibility requirements independently executable under the operator-selected seven sequential slices, without depending on a later slice to fix an earlier artifact's keyboard or focus behavior? [Consistency, Spec §Review Topology Resolution, Plan §Slice Stack]
- [x] CHK025 Are accessibility remediations constrained to the existing gallery contract and no shared foundation changes, avoiding speculative framework, routing, storage, or export additions? [Scope, Spec §FR-019, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK026 Are projected implementation LOC ceilings preserved after accessibility requirements are specified, with any new scope reflected in the slice ledger before implementation? [Scope, Spec §FR-017, Plan §Reviewability Checkpoint]
